gloss: to squeeze out; to extract; to milk

forms.label: ている past polite

definitions.gloss: to squeeze out; to extract; to press out
definitions.explanation: To extract liquid or essence from something by applying pressure. Used for juicing fruit, pressing oil, extracting flavor, etc.
To draw milk from a cow or other animal.

examples.japanese: ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}る。
⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}って⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To squeeze out the juice and make a drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリーブ→オリーブ：10808_oriibu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}る⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{伝|つた}わっている→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: The method of extracting oil from olives has been passed down since ancient times.

examples.english: Every morning, there is the task of milking at the farm.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

KANJI DISTINCTION:
{搾|しぼ}る vs. ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧ — both read しぼる but use different kanji:
- {搾|しぼ}る: to squeeze out, extract by pressing (juice, oil, milk)
- ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to wring (a towel), to narrow down (choices), to strangle

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}る: to squeeze juice
- ⟦{乳|ちち}→乳：19347_chichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}る: to milk
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}る: to press oil
- {搾|しぼ}りたて: freshly squeezed/milked

ASPECT (ている):
{搾|しぼ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing action of squeezing or milking.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{搾取|さくしゅ}→搾取：12820_sakushu⟧: exploitation (figuratively "squeezing" people)
